neighbours.label: a word in a statement that something has never or not yet happened ('has never been broken', 'not a necessity'); the output promotes ' anything', ' nor', ' any'
fire: That old world record has never been beaten by anyone.
In our climate an air conditioner has never been a necessity.
The seal on the jar has never been broken.
So far, this peak has never been climbed in winter.
A car has never been a necessity for me in the city.
That promise has never been kept by any mayor.
The treaty between them has never been broken.
Their secret code has never been cracked by experts.

Most homes in our climate have an air conditioner.
Open the jar and pour out the fruit.
Climbers reached this peak in winter last year.
In the city I drive a car to work.
